text.description_html:
Kawneer Husky Door Closer "Shotgun Closer" Retrofit

The Global TC7700 series and the original Kawneer Husky "Shotgun" concealed overhead closer models are Discontinued. This is a Retrofit closer so you can keep your Kawneer doors.

*Please note: This closer will NOT fit into headers less than 1-3/4" x 4". You must change the door closer arm when doing a Husky Closer Retrofit. You may also need to drill holes in the door closer header cover to access the (2) adjustment screws and make modifications to the mounting points. Front and back mounting brackets are included in the set.

Compact design offers an excellent hidden automatic overhead door closing solution. Center-pivoted for single and double acting (door opens in both directions) doors. Consistent closure speed is assured every time with its temperature-sensitive hydraulic fluid.

Features of Husky Retrofit Door Closers

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Cast Iron Housing
  • High Tensile Steel Camshaft and Pistons
  • Swing: Optional 90 or 105 degrees
  • Non Handed
  • Double Acting (Door can swing both ways)
  • Optional Non-Hold Open or Hold Open versions
  • 5 Year Manufacturer's Warranty

Specifications for Medium #4 (Most Common):

  • Maximum Door Weight: 175 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 44" interior / 36" exterior
  • Kawneer# 37-627: (TC7031) #4 Non-Hold Open, 105 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-628: (TC7032) #4 Hold Open 90 Degrees, 90 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-629: (TC7030) #4 Hold Open 105 Degrees, 105 Degree Back Stop

Specifications for Light #3:

  • Maximum Door Weight: 125 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 36" interior / 30" exterior
  • Kawneer# 37-623: (TC7023) #3 Non-Hold Open, 90 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-624: (TC7021) #3 Non-Hold Open, 105 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-625: (TC7022) #3 Hold Open 90 Degrees, 90 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-626: (TC7020) #3 Hold Open 105 Degrees, 105 Degree Back Stop

Specifications for Heavy #5:

  • Maximum Door Weight: 225 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 48" interior / 42" exterior
  • Kawneer# 37-630: (TC7041) #5 Non-Hold Open, 105 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-631: (TC7042) #5 Hold Open 90 Degrees, 90 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-632: (TC7040) #5 Hold Open 105 Degrees, 105 Degree Back Stop

2 different Closer Arms are available:

    Center Hung Doors - Double or Single Acting
  • (KRM) End Load Arm "K" Type End Load Arm (KRM) assembly: 5/8" deep top rail
    • Offset Hung Doors - Single Acting
  • (OFFSET-ARM-2) Offset Arm and Track Offset Arm and Track assembly: 5/8" deep top rail

This concealed closer has two-speed closing control to prevent the door from slamming against the stop on single acting applications, and to prevent over-swing on double acting applications. Replacement for Kawneer Husky door closers.
